The project uses the unmodified upstream/provider binary build. No FFmpeg
source code is included in this repository and no FFmpeg source modifications
were made for this project. The shipped runtime is ffmpeg.exe plus the shared
libav*/sw* DLLs listed in BUILD_INFO.txt.
